name: Sincronizada (Fried Ham and Cheese Tortilla Sandwich)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Heat up some oil in a pan over medium heat.
On a cutting board, with two tortillas, place a slice of deli ham and then queso fresco in the middle, and place another tortilla on top.
When the oil is hot, place the raw sincronizada on the pan and let the first side brown for a few minutes until the outside becomes crispy.
Once the first side is golden brown, flip the sincronizada over and brown the other side to crisp up in the same manner.
After a few more minutes, place the sincronizada on a plate with napkins, and enjoy.

culture.text: The quesadilla sincronizada is a flour tortilla-based sandwich made by placing ham, vegetables and a portion of cheese between two flour tortillas. They are then grilled or even lightly fried until the cheese melts and the tortillas become crispy, cut into halves or wedges and served, usually with salsa and pico de gallo, avocado or guacamole on top.
